{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask]

# Remove refunded orders
completed_only = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of completed orders after cleaning
print(f'Number of completed orders after removing QA and refunded: {len(completed_only)}')

# Compute average revenue per completed order
avg_revenue = completed_only['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Average revenue per completed order: {avg_revenue:.2f}')"}
